resources.string: Vulkan 1.3 only. Generates one intermediate frame for stable 30 FPS input. Requires imported Lossless Scaling shaders.
Import shaders from your purchased Lossless.dll

Select Lossless.dll from your purchased Lossless Scaling installation. This imports LSFG 3.1 Performance FP32 shaders locally without running the DLL. Shader files are shared by all games; frame generation can be enabled per game. Vulkan 1.3 is required. Frame generation may add latency and visual artifacts.
Shaders imported. Enable LSFG in graphics settings.
